articles.title: Crypto’s favorite $90 trillion trading product is coming to Wall Street, but big banks are taking it slow
articles.snippet: Regulated perpetual futures are officially landing in the U.S., but while agile trading firms and crypto exchanges race to capture massive retail demand, traditional Wall Street banks are holding back until liquidity, rules, and infrastructure mature.

articles.title: Cloud data firm Storj files for Chapter 11, extending a week of crypto failures. Token slides 16%
articles.snippet: The decentralized data storage company says operations continue and proposes that token holders take equity in the restructured business — an unusual arrangement in bankruptcy.

articles.title: Storj files for bankruptcy, explores equity path for tokenholders
articles.snippet: The decentralized storage provider says its network will continue operating during Chapter 11 as it explores a court-approved ownership mechanism for STORJ holders.
